P02.reason: Active shallow surround is2.125x1x2.125 blocks; tall surround2.125x2x2.125. Literal upright pane geometry and all component cells unchanged.

P03.reason: All earlier pane states remain in Block assets; current dictionary and inspector label resolved mesh bounds.

P04.reason: Earlier full-glass examples retained. New generated set uses panes only. Source alpha and reverse-order GPU checks retained.

P05.reason: Emission remains literal material metadata. Slime/honey/terracotta unlit; pearl and lower jack are sources. No atmosphere shader or arbitrary highlight introduced.

P06.reason: Single pane colour per new family palette. Earlier mixed-colour silhouette comparison remains available separately.

P07.reason: Five source-backed palettes and one-block reference inspected below; existing texture mapping used. Blue core corrected after direct texture comparison.

P08.reason: Default below and front/side/above native overview rendered; direct inspector retained. Manual mouse interaction remains untested.

P09.reason: Protected user settings/lighting hashes unchanged. Old generator, dictionary, assembly, renderer and imported asset manifest unchanged.

P10.reason: Scope narrowed explicitly; larger reference structures remain unresolved. Minecraft1.19.3 assets, unknown source camera/material assignments and untested manual clicks remain limitations.

P11.reason: Generated family has exactly two whole parts. Components own original cells; family selection changes pair/palette, not their arrangement.

P12.reason: All 18 palette assemblies retain component counts, reject overlapping cells and resolve material-dependent pane connections. All new ring blocks remain upright.

P13.reason: Existing geometry retained, active set selected from literal crops. Only slime and blue core material assignments changed. Exact reference camera/hidden cells remain unrecovered.

P14.reason: Same-material full glass internal-face culling retained; connected pane end caps now use source flags. Different-material interfaces retained; nonintersecting recipes only.

P15.reason: Every new ring is single-colour panes; mixed/full-glass examples remain earlier-only.

P16.reason: Full-height two-row surround paired with tall core in new family. Earlier one-high/two-high comparison retained as history.

P17.reason: Indexed family selection retained, palette selection restricted to source-linked indices. 12000 new-family choices check that no unsupported palette is selected; older12000-choice checks also pass.

P18.reason: Every active grid label names its source crop; exact inspector shows materials/emission/counts and per-palette observations/assumptions. Manual interaction untested.

P19.reason: Honey/pumpkin/jack variants retain detached panes; normal core materials accept arms. Literal same belt cells can therefore resolve differently.

P20.reason: Per-exhibit light groups retained. No shared lighting formula edits. Night previews have no shadows, occlusion or bloom.

P21.reason: Active set contains only horizontal shallow/full-height surrounds. Historical vertical experiments remain outside active set.

P22.reason: Tall white/cyan patterned core inside a blue surround spanning its height. Inference/limit: Light-blue glazed terracotta is supported by direct source-texture comparison; two blocks are inferred. Exact terracotta rotations and hidden rear cells are not recovered.

P23.reason: Latest scope clarification supersedes increasing shape variety with inventions. Current active set deliberately has two body arrangements, three pairings and five source examples.

P24.reason: Complete pairing remains intact; active palettes must cite a source crop. Long/flat/stepped extensions and unsupported colour swaps are historical only.

P25.reason: Only source-tagged touching same-material pane end caps are omitted. Top/bottom untagged faces remain; tall-row seam is a documented discrepancy. Source flags and exact connected-pair face count checked.

P26.reason: Default overview is exactly pink/slime/honey/yellow-stack/blue-stack. Generated seeds contain only these sources. Body/ring dictionaries default to their components. History requires explicit selection.
